name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, windows-2025]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Test
        run: |
          zig build test
          echo "done: ${{ github.sha }}"
      - run: echo ok
